new_assets.title: Shifted B_s Encoding for Signed Ternary Sparse States
new_assets.statement: Let a_1,...,a_m be a B_s set modulo N with representatives in [0,N-1]. Set L=2s(N-1)+1 and w_i=L+a_i. Then x -> sum_i x_i w_i is injective on every x in {-1,0,1}^m with support at most s.
new_assets.proof_core: A collision first forces equal total charge because the residual magnitude is below L. Moving negative terms across gives equal-length sums of k terms, where k is half the total support of the two states and therefore k<=s. Pad to s terms and invoke B_s uniqueness. The resulting multiset equality is exactly equality of the signed coefficient vectors.
new_assets.novelty_boundary: The B_s input is classical. The exact signed charge-shift formulation was generated by composing the existing binary B_s and signed support-two assets; historical novelty has not been checked.

new_assets.title: Optimal Signed Ternary Sparse Exponent
new_assets.statement: For fixed s, the minimum possible largest positive integer weight that exactly encodes every {-1,0,1}-valued vector of support at most s is Theta_s(m^s).
new_assets.proof_core: There are sum_{r=0}^s 2^r binom(m,r)=Theta_s(m^s) states but only 2sW+1 possible sums with maximum weight W, giving Omega_s(m^s). SGN-04 plus a classical B_s construction in a cyclic group of order O_s(m^s) gives O_s(m^s).
new_assets.novelty_boundary: Likely related to signed/generalized Sidon sequence literature. The campaign has closed the theorem internally, but historical novelty is unverified.

new_assets.title: Signed Three-Sparse Theta(m^3) Closure
new_assets.statement: The optimal largest positive integer weight for encoding all {-1,0,1}-valued support-at-most-three vectors is Theta(m^3).
new_assets.novelty_boundary: Corollary of SGN-05; historical novelty follows the parent theorem's unresolved status.

new_assets.title: General Bounded-Coefficient Constructive Upper Bound
new_assets.statement: For fixed A,s, a B_{A*s} set plus the same charge separator yields positive integer weights of largest size O_{A,s}(m^(A*s)) that exactly encode all support-at-most-s vectors in [-A,A]^m.
new_assets.proof_core: Expand coefficient magnitudes as repeated copies only inside the proof. Equal charge makes the moved positive/negative multisets have equal size at most A*s; B_{A*s} uniqueness recovers multiplicities.
new_assets.novelty_boundary: A constructive baseline, not claimed optimal. It improves the previously contemplated generic B_{2As} overkill to B_{As} by exploiting charge separation.

conjecture_updates.new_scope: Closed for ternary coefficients A=1. Still open for general coefficient magnitude A>=2; current constructive upper bound is O_{A,s}(m^(A*s)).
